metadata.title: High-Contrast Editorial Portrait with Stiletto Nails

retrievalProfile.description: Generates a dramatic, high-contrast close-up portrait featuring a subject in a dark hood with prominent black stiletto nails and warm, golden-hour studio lighting.
excludeWhen: minimalist or no-makeup looks are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, square-cropped portrait of a person with blonde bangs wearing a black hood. The subject's hand is positioned near the mouth, showcasing long, glossy black stiletto-shaped nails. The lighting is directional and warm, creating deep shadows on a black background while highlighting the skin's texture and the sharp angles of the nails.
coreVisualRelationships: Hand placement framing the lower face and lips
Contrast between warm skin tones and deep black fabric/background
Sharpness of the stiletto nails against the soft texture of the skin
Direct, sultry gaze toward the camera lens
coreInvariants: Black fabric hood framing the face
Deep black negative space in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, face and hand occupying 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the hand with stiletto nails.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the sharp nails at the bottom left, up the fingers to the lips, and finally to the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background surrounding the hooded head.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the lit skin and the dark surroundings; warm saturation in the highlights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a person with blonde bangs wearing a black hood, hand near face with long black stiletto nails, warm directional lighting, black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, use a high-contrast serif font in white or gold, positioned in the negative space of the black background.

verificationChecks: Ensure nails are sharp stiletto shape and glossy black
Check that the hood is solid black and frames the face tightly
Verify lighting is warm and directional with deep shadows
Confirm the background is pure black

mustRedesign: Do not include any logos or brand marks on the clothing

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and nails
Smooth skin gradients under warm light
Clean separation between subject and black background

postGenerationChecks: Is the lighting warm and golden?
Is the composition a tight close-up?
recipe.reuseFormula: Editorial Portrait = (Tight Close-up + Black Hood) * (Warm Directional Lighting) + (Glossy Black Stiletto Nails) / (Solid Black Background)
